description: This file defines the SessionHandler class for Drupal, implementing session management by reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting session data stored in a database table. It includes schema definition and table creation logic.

classes.name: SessionHandler
classes.description: Default session handler class for Drupal, managing session data in a database with methods for opening, reading, writing, destroying, garbage collection, and schema definition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SessionHandler with request stack, database connection, and time service.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a session; always returns true.

methods.name: doRead
methods.description: Reads session data from the database based on session ID.

methods.name: doWrite
methods.description: Writes session data to the database, creating the table if necessary.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session; always returns true.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys a session by session ID.

methods.name: doDestroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from the database.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by deleting old sessions based on lifetime.

methods.name: updateTimestamp
methods.description: No-op; Drupal manages session expiry elsewhere.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the database schema for the sessions table.

methods.name: ensureTableExists
methods.description: Checks if the sessions table exists and creates it if not.
